AcceptScoreDesc: Match accept score (0-1, normalized correlation) — low values risk false matches on similar edge structures
AccumThresholdDesc: Accumulator vote threshold for circle candidates — lower is more sensitive but increases false detections
AngleZoneDegDesc: Rotation search zone ±deg, centered on the taught pose. 0 = taught pose only
BlobPolarityDesc: Bright when the product (blob) is brighter than the background, Dark otherwise — binarization direction. A wrong polarity mistakes the background for the product
BlobThresholdDesc: Fixed binarization threshold (0–255) — used when Auto Threshold (Otsu) is off
CaliperEdgeSelectDesc: Edge selection — Best (strongest) / First (first from the −s side) / Last (first from the +s side)
CaliperPolarityDesc: Edge polarity — relative to the +search direction
CaliperProjectionLengthDesc: Averaging width (px) — perpendicular to the search direction
CannyThresholdDesc: Upper threshold of the internal Canny edge detection — lower includes weaker edges (lower threshold is half, automatic)
CircleMaxRmsPxDesc: Allowed fit residual RMS - root mean square of radial deviation from the fitted circle (input image pixels). Rises when the target is not circular or calipers catch a different structure. A large ignore count lowers the residual as well, so set this against that value
CircleNumToIgnoreDesc: Outliers excluded from fitting — worst radial residuals removed then refit
CoarseScaleDesc: Coarse-pass image downscale (0.1-1) — applies to BOTH the angle sweep and the scale-search coarse stage. Lower is faster but coarse angle/scale discrimination degrades (scale has no fine re-search, so this affects scale more)
ColorTrainedDesc: Whether the color band has been learned. Register it with the learn-color button
EdgeSelectDesc: Edge selection — Best (strongest) / First (first from −normal) / Last (first from +normal)
FillHolesAtBorderDesc: Also fills interiors that open only through the border (arch shapes standing on the border). The border is treated as a wall — only background reachable from the four corners counts as outside. With a region enabled, the region boundary plays the border role (wall and corners alike). Used only while 'Fill enclosed holes' is on.
FillHolesDesc: Count fully enclosed holes as part of the blob. A hole that opens to the outside anywhere stays background. Turn this on to measure the outline area of a part with a hole through it.
FillHolesEdgeDesc: Fills fully enclosed interiors of kept blobs with 255 so they stand as solid regions on the edge plane. Turn on to match donut-like targets as a mass instead of a thin rim. The plane changes — patterns on this plane need retraining and lines re-teaching.
HueCenterDesc: Center hue of the learned color. OpenCV convention 0-179 (1 step = 2 deg) - red is around 0/179, green 60, blue 120. Usually filled by Learn color
HueTolDesc: Allowed deviation from the hue center. 90 or more ignores hue entirely - for achromatic (metallic/gray) targets Learn color opens this automatically and relies on saturation/value only
MagnitudeScaleDesc: Edge magnitude scale — magnitude × scale saturated to 0-255. Higher brightens weak edges
MaxAngleDevDegDesc: Allowed deviation between the detected line and the search segment direction. Lines are undirected, so a 180-degree flipped detection counts as zero deviation. Segment, calipers and detected line all live in input image space, so "did it stray from where I placed it" is judged exactly here. Note this is not the same quantity as how far the part actually rotated (physical angle) - under anisotropic subsampling the two diverge, so a caller needing the physical angle must convert to source space and measure separately
MaxCountDesc: How many non-overlapping matches to return at most. 1 (default) returns only the highest score, which is the previous behaviour. With 2 or more, the area around each match is erased from the score map and the next highest score is taken, and so on. Returning fewer than requested is normal; the caller decides what to do with them. Each extra match repeats the refine stage, so it gets slower accordingly.
MaxRmsPxDesc: Allowed fit residual RMS - root mean square of point distances from the fitted line (input image pixels). A clean line stays under 0.1; a segment straddling a bend rises to 1-5. A large ignore count lowers the residual as well, so set this against that value
MinPixelsDesc: Minimum blob area (px) — smaller blobs removed as noise
MinSepPctDesc: Minimum centre distance for two matches to count as distinct, as a percentage of the template diagonal. At 100 they must be a full diagonal apart, which guarantees the two template rectangles cannot overlap at any rotation. The default of 50 accepts matches overlapping by up to half, because targets often sit right next to each other (adjacent faces of a polygon, for instance). Raising it erases genuine targets that sit close together; lowering it lets the same target come back at slightly shifted positions. Overlap is judged by position only, so a different angle at the same place counts as the same match. Ignored when only one match is requested.
MorphOpenDesc: Morphological opening kernel size - removes speckles smaller than this from the mask. 0 = off, 3-7 recommended (even values are rounded up to odd)
NumToIgnoreDesc: Outliers excluded from fitting — worst residuals removed then refit
OverlapDegDesc: Overlap angle past the unwrap seam (0°) — template angular width + margin. Prevents seam-straddling targets from being cut; edit the radial band via the concentric ring grips on the display
Polarity1Desc: Polarity of the second EdgePair edge (relative to the +search direction, positioned after Edge0)
ProjectionLengthDesc: Averaging width along the segment direction (px)
RadialPolarityDesc: Edge polarity — relative to outward radial (+) direction (DarkToLight = inside dark → outside bright)
RadialSearchLengthDesc: Total search length along the radial direction (px)
RadiusTolPctDesc: Search radius range as ±% of the expected circle (Expect shape) radius — narrower is faster and suppresses false detections. Edit the expected circle by dragging the display shape
RegionShapeDesc: Shape of the judgment/sampling region. Rect = rotatable rectangle (general area) / Ring = annulus band (for ring-shaped targets like washers - excludes the similar-looking center such as a bolt head via the inner radius). Changing it switches the edit shape, color learning and judgment to that shape
RingPolarityDesc: Bright when the material is brighter than the background, Dark otherwise — flipping it inverts the fill ratio
RingRMaxDesc: Outer edge of the band — the span between the two radii is where fill is measured
RingRMinDesc: Inner edge of the band — pixels closer to the center than this are not counted
RingThresholdDesc: Binarization threshold (0-255) used when the automatic threshold (Otsu) is off
SampleXDesc: Horizontal subsampling ratio (1 = original). Changing it alters downstream tool coordinate space — re-teach required
SampleYDesc: Vertical subsampling ratio. Anisotropic use corrects measured angle to source space but degrades pattern rotation tracking — isotropic recommended
SatMaxDesc: Pixels above this saturation are excluded (0-255). Usually left at 255
SatMinDesc: Pixels below this saturation are excluded (0-255). Too low and gray background gets included
ScaleStepPctDesc: Scale search step % — precision is ±step/2; smaller steps increase coarse search cost
SearchDirDegDesc: Profile search direction (deg, image atan2 convention — the +s travel direction)
SearchLengthDesc: Total search length along the normal (px)
TangentProjectionLengthDesc: Averaging width along the tangent direction (px)
ThresholdDesc: Binarization threshold (0-255) — only pixels at or above become blob candidates
ToggleSpanDesc: Toggle expected arc span between 180° and 360° — start angle resets to 0°. Fine-tune with the display shape grips
TrainColorDesc: Derives the HSV band from the color distribution inside the region. Place the region (rectangle or ring band) tightly on the target on the train image before pressing - background pixels widen the band and cause false hits. The result can be fine-tuned via the color band fields below
TrainColorFailed: Color learning failed - make sure the region lies inside a color train image and try again.
TrainDesc: Run pattern training — register the train image first
TrainFailed: Pattern training failed — register a train image and try again.
TrainShapeDesc: Shape of the pattern train region. Rect = rotatable rectangle (default) / Circle - for round targets (bolt heads, around holes) it keeps corner background out of the template, and the mask is rotation-invariant which suits angle search. Changing it switches the edit shape; the next Train uses the new shape (an existing template keeps the shape it was trained with)
UseAngleGateDesc: Treat as not-found when the detected line deviates from the search segment direction by more than the limit below. If the segment sits where the pattern pose placed it, that direction is the line angle expected once the part has rotated - so a large deviation means the segment landed on an adjacent face or corner and caught a different structure. The reference stays the original segment even with refit enabled
UseAngleSearchDesc: Enable rotation (angle) search — off fixes to the trained pose (angle zone/steps and coarse angle sweep skipped)
UseCropDesc: Keep only the region worth looking at. Anything else is search cost and a chance to match the wrong thing. Drag the region on the display. Changing it shifts every downstream tool coordinate, so re-teach after.
UseOtsuDesc: On uses the Otsu automatic threshold — flexible against lighting variation. Turn off and use the fixed threshold when background interference destabilizes it
UseRefitDesc: Two-pass detection - re-places calipers on the first fit and measures again. When the target is shifted or tilted from the taught position the first pass meets edges obliquely and distorts subpixel results; the second pass converges as the normals align with the edge. Roughly doubles detection time. Falls back to the first result if the second fails
UseRegionDesc: Restrict to region — edit by dragging the display shape
UseRmsGateDesc: Treat as not-found when the fit residual (RMS) exceeds the limit below. A high residual means the points do not lie on one line/circle, so the angle or center cannot be trusted even if it looks plausible - surfaced as a detection failure instead of a silent bad measurement. With refit enabled it applies to the second pass only
UseScaleSearchDesc: Enable scale search — tolerates pattern size variation (adds search time)
UseSearchRegionDesc: Restrict search region — off searches the whole image; edit by dragging the display shape
ValMaxDesc: Pixels brighter than this are excluded (0-255). Lower it to reject specular highlights
ValMinDesc: Pixels darker than this are excluded (0-255). Filters out shadows
